justification: Inspected `byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/implementation/auxiliary/TypeProxy.java` (lines 599-710) and `byte-buddy-dep/src/test/java/net/bytebuddy/implementation/auxiliary/TypeProxyCreationTest.java` (lines 343-360). `MethodCall` is a compact inner implementation with only two entry points (`prepare` and `appender`) and two small nested helpers (`Appender` and `AccessorMethodInvocation`), all centered on one concern: defining the `target` field and emitting proxy dispatch bytecode.
